//! `past_window` declared twice. Every read is owned by a permitted
//! name, so assertion (1) is silent and only the declaration pin fires.

fn base_s() -> i64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}

fn past_window(width_s: i64) -> (i64, i64) {
    let now_s = std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64;
    (now_s - 60 - width_s, now_s - 60)
}

mod other {
    pub fn past_window(width_s: i64) -> (i64, i64) {
        (0 - width_s, 0)
    }
}
